assumptions.impact: Offline battery/grid model, not hardware acceptance or official scoring.
assumptions.statement: 14kWh, 5kW charge/discharge, eta .95/1, grid import/export 20/5kW are local experiment boundaries.

assumptions.impact: Both arms use identical experimental starting energy.
assumptions.statement: Slot-initial SOC site1/2/3=8/55/7%; prewarm never advances batteries.

assumptions.impact: Not device/firmware proven. Pure-PV export above5kW and import above20kW still fail; no extra generalized curtailment.
assumptions.statement: Both arms share local actual-discharge projection min(step-accepted discharge,max(5+actual load-actual PV,0)); requested power is preserved before projection.

assumptions.impact: Forecast adaptation, not archived official forecasts or known future published prices.
assumptions.statement: Future weather and buy/sell tariffs repeat the latest ended same-clock 24h history; actual tariffs only settle completed decisions.

assumptions.impact: Do not claim contamination-free predictive generalization.
assumptions.statement: Fixed model training window was not independently verified; models may have seen the scored window. This is not a strict contamination-free generalization evaluation.

assumptions.impact: P_j and cash are computed per site before aggregation.
assumptions.statement: Source tariffs are preserved per site, including cross-site mismatch.
